Elemental Mastery is a level 90 Elemental shaman talent. When activated it grants 30% haste for 20 seconds, which applies to both casting and attacking.
The Elemental Invasions are invasions by elementals at different locations on Kalimdor, occurring sporadically every few days. They take place in Silithus, Winterspring, Un'Goro Crater, and Azshara.

The Elemental Plane is a pocket dimension created by the Keepers to imprison Azeroth's elementals. The prison plane consists of four interlinked domains, each representing one of the major elements - Skywall (air), Deepholm (earth), the Abyssal Maw (water) and the Firelands (fire). Highlord Demitrian described it as "the core of this world". The four domains of the Elemental Plane are featured in the Cataclysm expansion.

Electrocutioner 6000 is an elite named spider tank found on the upper-level platform in the Launch Bay in Gnomeregan. This machine is driven by one of the insane gnomish lieutenants who still follow the leadership of . He was once the sole source of the Workshop Key, which opened the back door entrance to the instance. After his destruction, some parts of the tank have been recovered and returned to a safe place in Tinker Town, in Ironforge. The Electrocutioner Leg was among them.

Elekks (sometimes pluralized as elekk) are a species of large, elephant-like creatures native to Draenor that the draenei commonly employ as mounts. Elekks became sickly and corrupt as a result of Draenor's fel corruption and subsequent transformation into Outland. Patient and strong, the elekk exemplify the draenei attitude towards the hardships of life.

Elemental conglomerates are creatures from the Elemental Plane, a location that encompass all four elemental forces in a single area. Because of this the planes' creatures have adapted to more than one region by taking on the aspects of one or more such areas. Each kind shares two or more aspects of the basic elemental types. *If a creature shares two elemental aspects they are known as "dual elemental"-type. *If a creature shares three elemental aspects it is known as a "triumvirate elemental"-type. *If a creature shares all four elemental aspects it is known as a "complete" or "primal elemental"-type.

Elemental sprites are tiny creatures that live in the Elemental Plane. Elemental creatures exist in many forms. At the lowest level of the elemental hierarchy are the elemental sprites, tiny creatures that exist as a living aspect akin to their element (lightning for the air realm for example). In the hierarchy, they are just below mephits.

Elegy is a World of Warcraft novella by Christie Golden. It recounts the War of the Thorns from the Alliance's point of view, while its companion novella A Good War details the Horde perspective. Both novellas take place simultaneously. The story takes place after the events of Before the Storm. A limited edition hardback book containing both A Good War and Elegy along with exclusive original artwork will be included in the World of Warcraft: Battle for Azeroth Collector's Edition. Both stories were announced to become available online later in 2018, but buying the Collector's Edition would remain the only way to own the hardback version containing original artwork. The Elemental Bound Chest starts the Trial of the Elements scenario in the Primalist Future of Thaldraszus. Interact with the chest to start the scenario, then fend off a few waves of enemies, capping off with the boss Zurkharus. On victory, open the Chest of the Elements for a Dragon Isles Artifact, a Titan Relic (item), and a chance at item level 379 armor or equipment.

Elders' Gift is the northern lava stream coming out of Zaqali Caldera in northeastern Zaralek Cavern. The southern branch is the Molten Overflow. Occupied by the Zaqali djaradin, the rare elite magmammoth Magmanesha spawns here. Also present are Warchanter Ronvath (for Intercepting Communications), and unnamed berserkers, flametongues (for Thinning Their Defenses), ironfists, and the Zaqali Forge Virtuoso. The area is bordered by the Battlefield Ruins to the north, Obsidian Spire Outpost to the northeast, Acidbite Ravine to the east and southeast, Igira's Watch to the south and southwest, and Zaqali Caldera past the watch to the west.

An elf is a long-lived humanoid species native to Azeroth known for keen perception, grace, and great spellwork. They are one of the longest-lived species on Azeroth. The specific origins of elves remained lost to history for millennia, until Brann Bronzebeard confirmed that the first elves were originally dark trolls that were transformed by the Well of Eternity.
